review_candidates.description: About The Role About Us Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Headquartered in Saudi Arabia and growing throughout the region, Soar’s mission is to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools, delivered through a multi-purpose platform designed for a simple and seamless user experience. The Mission Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth. Trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work (sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing), with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform. You will own features and workflows from discovery to launch, work side by side with engineers and designers, and learn fast in one of the most exciting product spaces today.
